Great to meet you over email. Really appreciate you taking the time to explore Redwood. I wanted to align on a short discovery + demo (30–45m) where we can:
- Understand your current inference constraints (latency / cost / compliance)
- Share a concise demo of how Redwood routes and isolates inference for regulated workloads
- Collect the initial security/procurement artifacts so we can send a tailored evidence pack

Could you confirm a 30–45 minute window next week? Here are a few slots (all PT):
- Tue 6/15 10:00–10:45
- Tue 6/15 14:00–14:45
- Wed 6/16 09:30–10:15

Please add anyone else on your side who should join (engineering lead, procurement, security). I’ve CC’d Karthik (SE) to propose a short technical agenda and Marissa on the account plan.

Initial asks I’ll bring to the call if helpful: SOC 2 summary, expected QPS and peak sequence length, any data residency constraints, and who handles procurement/POs at StrataCorp. I’ll attach a short "evidence checklist" and a draft agenda.

Looking forward —
Ben

Hey all —

Thanks for looping me in. Proposed technical agenda (20–25m demo + 10–15m Q&A):
1) 5m: Quick intro & success criteria (Ellie / Samir)
2) 10m: Architecture overview — routing, dedicated pools, and VPC/private options
3) 10m: Live demo: routing by policy, KV/prefix caching demo, and an example rollback to quantized variant
4) 10–15m: Q&A — include Marc if he can join for security questions

I can cover points 2–3 and will prepare a short slide with latency numbers for the exact sequence lengths you mentioned. For the demo we’ll need one engineer with SSH access (only if we demo deployment flows) — otherwise we’ll use a recorded capture.

Ben, I uploaded an evidence bundle here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-demo-intake (initial-evidence.zip). I included the SOC 2 summary already in Ben's message and a small README describing what’s in the zip.

I’m available Tue 6/15 14:00 PT and Wed 6/16 09:30 PT — both work.

Thanks,
Karthik
